items.title: BTS' Jin, Aespa's Ningning and Xiao Zhan Lead Gucci's Primavera Campaign
items.summary: Singapore fashion outlet covers Gucci's newly released Primavera campaign, framing global brand ambassadors Jin, Ningning and Xiao Zhan as the leads within Demna's star-studded cast; positions the campaign around themes of love, connection and reinvention, targeted at the K-pop/C-pop-driven SEA fan audience.

items.title: Gucci Primavera 2026: A Slow Song, A Dance Floor And The Shape Of Demna's Gucci
items.summary: SEA regional trade/lifestyle title reviews the Primavera campaign film directed by Johan Renck, featuring Kate Moss lip-syncing to a 1989 Chris Isaak ballad; frames the shift toward 'lightness and ease' as a deliberate departure from Gucci's maximalist past and the first cohesive storytelling statement of Demna's tenure.

items.title: New Style Vocabulary: Gucci Fall/Winter Primavera Preview in Manila
items.summary: Philippine daily covers Gucci's exclusive Fall/Winter 2026 Primavera preview event held at Greenbelt 4, Manila on 31 July, introducing local media and clients to the new pragmatic silhouette direction (fluid tailoring, body-aware cuts) and the updated Bamboo 1947 bag ahead of broader SEA retail rollout.

items.title: Demna Calls on Tom Brady, Xiao Zhan, Ningning, Shawn Mendes and More for Gucci Primavera Campaign
items.summary: Trade-press report on the Primavera campaign's global casting logic, quoting Demna on wanting the film to read as a music video about 'emotional awakening'; establishes the campaign as the definitive brand-positioning signal one season into his tenure, relevant baseline context for SEA ambassador coverage.

items.title: Kering Closes 217 Stores as Gucci Sales Plunge 22%
items.summary: Critical-angle business coverage: Kering has closed at least 217 stores amid Gucci's continuing sales decline (down 22% in the latest reported period), with roughly 40% of the 2026 closure plan concentrated in Asian markets including Asia-Pacific locations; direct relevance to SEA retail footprint decisions even though the report itself is global.

items.source: WWD Sourcing Journal (The RealReal 2026 Resale Report via WWD)
items.title: Vintage Demand Surges as Luxury Resale Shoppers Get Specific
items.summary: Critical-angle resale-market data point: The RealReal's 2026 report shows the Gucci Marmont's average resale price falling from $1,600 to $853, a sharp depreciation contrasted against strong-performing archive styles like the Jackie; used regionally as evidence feeding SEA secondhand-market chatter about which Gucci bags hold value.

items.title: Gucci Just Unveiled Its Star-Studded Primavera Campaign
items.summary: Enthusiast handbag-community blog (PurseForum's sister site) reacts to the Primavera campaign cast and visuals from a bag-collector's lens, weighing whether the new 'lightness and ease' aesthetic translates into desirable new bag silhouettes versus past maximalist hits; read widely by the same SEA collector audience active on PurseForum.

items.title: BTS Member Gets Brutally Trolled Over New Look (Gucci Primavera styling)
items.summary: Aggregation of X/Twitter netizen backlash against Gucci global ambassador Jin's bold eye-makeup styling in the Primavera campaign photos; critical comments mocked the look and questioned whether he could carry it, illustrating fan-driven negative sentiment circulating on SNS around the campaign rollout relevant to SEA's large K-pop fan base. No aggregate engagement counts were visible on the page.
